name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Decline Fly
steps: Set the bench to a decline, secure your feet and lie back with one dumbbell above your chest, palm inward.
Keep a slight bend in your working elbow and place your free hand on your hip to stabilize your trunk.
Open your working arm out to the side in a wide arc until you feel a controlled stretch across your chest.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above your chest along the same arc, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Maintain the same slight elbow angle throughout so the movement stays a fly rather than turning into a press.
Stop the descent before your shoulder rolls forward or feels pinched.
